title: Automatically compute and display related pages based on shared tags.
description: Reads each page's YAML frontmatter tags, scores pages against each other (Jaccard similarity) and exposes the result to Jinja. Optionally aligns with MaterialX/Material's built-in tags plugin configuration.

match_path.title: Regular expression to match pages to include.
match_path.description: A page whose src_uri doesn't match is excluded from the whole feature: never indexed, never shown as related content, never given related pages of its own.

section_title.title: Title exposed to Jinja as `related_content_section_title`.
section_title.description: Purely informational - the plugin doesn't render any HTML itself, your template decides where and how to use it.

css_class.title: CSS class exposed to Jinja as `related_content_css_class`.
css_class.description: Lets themes target a stable, known class without hardcoding it in the template, and lets integrators rename it to avoid clashing with an existing theme class.

max_related.title: Maximum related pages shown per page, manual and automatic combined.
max_related.description: Applied after sorting automatic candidates by descending score. Manual links (related_content.links) are counted against this total too - see max_manual_related.

max_manual_related.title: Maximum number of manual links honored within max_related.
max_manual_related.description: Manual links (related_content.links frontmatter) always take priority over automatic suggestions, up to this count. Remaining slots, up to max_related, go to automatic candidates.

min_score.title: Minimum Jaccard score for a page to be considered related.
min_score.description: Between 0 (no shared tag) and 1 (identical tag sets). Raise it for stricter, higher-confidence matches only.

weight_by_tag_rarity.title: Weight shared tags by how rarely they're used on the site.
weight_by_tag_rarity.description: When true, a shared tag counts for more the fewer pages use it (1 / page_count), instead of every tag counting equally.

use_material_tags.title: Enable/Disable alignment with MaterialX/Material's tags plugin configuration.
use_material_tags.description: When the active theme is materialx or material and its tags plugin is enabled, aligns tag filtering with its tags_allowed setting.

export_tags_json.title: Enable/Disable the fallback tags.json-shaped export.
export_tags_json.description: Automatically skipped when MaterialX/Material's own tags plugin already exports its own JSON, to avoid a duplicate.

tags_json_filename.title: Filename of the fallback JSON export, relative to site_dir.
